name: eudr-compliance-agent
title: EUDR Compliance & TRACES-NT MCP Server
description: Autonomous AI Agent compliance engine for EU Deforestation Regulation (EU 2023/1115). Verifies farm plot GIS polygons, Sentinel-2 satellite deforestation past 2020, VIES VAT numbers, and generates official TRACES-NT Due Diligence Statements (DDS).
author: nohosa001-pixel

tools.name: eudr_verify_plot
tools.description: Validates GIS coordinates and polygon boundaries against EUDR (EU 2023/1115) Art. 9 standards.

tools.name: eudr_check_deforestation
tools.description: Performs satellite radar triangulation and canopy loss detection against the 2020-12-31 baseline.

tools.name: eudr_render_satellite_map
tools.description: Generates visual multi-spectral satellite imagery metadata and NDVI canopy density radar visualization.

tools.name: eudr_verify_vies_vat
tools.description: Validates European Union B2B cross-border VAT numbers in real-time via the official EU Commission VIES engine.

tools.name: eudr_generate_dds
tools.description: Generates an EU TRACES-NT compliant Due Diligence Statement (DDS) XML package with official EUDR reference ID.

tools.name: eudr_verify_audit_integrity
tools.description: Verifies SHA-256 cryptographic chain of custody and tamper-evidence for an EUDR compliance audit bundle.

tools.name: eudr_estimate_compliance_cost
tools.description: Calculates estimated tier pricing and clearing fees in EUR for EUDR plot verification and TRACES-NT filing.

tools.name: eudr_create_payment_order
tools.description: Creates an on-chain USDC payment order for SaaS plan subscription with budget guardrails.

tools.name: eudr_confirm_payment
tools.description: Validates on-chain transaction hash for a payment order and issues the activated Pro API Key.

prompts.name: eudr_compliance_audit_prompt
prompts.description: Guides an autonomous agent through an end-to-end EUDR Art. 9 audit workflow.
